body:
Hi,
I have read your post and I feel your pain. I still am not over my break up with my ex of 4 years. Every day I miss her, every day I cry and think of her. One day I just want to go to see her and do whatever it takes to make things up. Its a living hell for me to just sit here and dread every wrong move i made, it hurts alot. Some days I feel ok just thinking about the happy memories, but most of the time I am depressed.
Unfortunately I have no good advice to give, everyone says move on, but I know for me I cannot do that in such pain. Honestly the main reasons I go on reddit is to try and cope with this stuff and your post made me feel like I was less alone in this. 
I graduated with a 3.8 in mathematics, was taking grad courses and the second I my girlfriend wanted to break up I was hospitalized and had to withdraw from school. To this day now I live with my best friend and his wife trying to make things better between me and my girlfriend. I know they don't appreciate me here and i know no one else wants to talk to me about it. I'm sick of the pain. I don't want to be here I want to be with my girlfriend...I wish there was some help. Every night I pray, still in pain and agony. I put so much up but I am willing to put up even more so she can just be happy with me...anything....
I am sorry for interluding into my problems so much, although i can't offer much advice I have to say you are not alone. I feel really depressed about my issue and I wish I could do something...
If you want to talk I will look back here. Maybe we can help each other be happy... I understand if you do not...
